About this Event

BOLLYWOOD NEON Dandiya Night 2026 for cause- Children's Mental Health Awareness supporting TAARIKA FOUNDATION and GYEF
BOLLYWOOD DANCE CONNECTION Bollywood Dance Connection and KASH CAFE Kash Cafe, Berkeley invite you and your family to Dandiya for a cause - Children's Mental Health Awareness supporting TAARIKA Foundation and GYEF
This year, we are honored to dedicate the event to supporting the missions of Taarika Foundation and Global Youth Empowerment Foundation (GYEF).
Taarika Foundation Taarika Foundation is committed to raising awareness about children's mental health, promoting education, reducing stigma, and connecting families with the support they need.
Global Youth Empowerment Foundation (GYEF) Global Youth Empowerment - empowers young people through education, cultural engagement, leadership development, and community service, creating opportunities that inspire confidence, purpose, and positive social impact… https://www.instagram.com/reel/DVvdSYWAa2W/?igsh=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ==&igsi=NTc4MTIwNjQ2YQ== GYEF, Global Youth Empowerment Foundation, runs food drives in Indian slums to provide one meal at a time in partnership with Rotary Club of Faridabad Aravalli project @UmeedaKiRasoi (insta). At 𝐆𝐘𝐄𝐅, our mission is to support and uplift children by sponsoring their education—one child at a time. But we can’t do this alone. We need your support to continue making a difference in their lives and in the community.
This event is more than a Garba and Dandiya celebration, it is a fundraiser and awareness initiative where every sponsorship, ticket purchased, and partnership helps strengthen these important missions.

Join us at Cupertino • San jose . Campbell BOLLYWOOD NEON DANDIYA NIGHT 2026 on 17th Oct, Sun at 901 Boynton Ave, San Jose, CA 95117 from 5:30 till 9:00 pm with 30 min of free Garba dance workshop
